title: Verification code for: The additive ambiguity of gravitational entropy fixed by the topology of the horizon
description: Symbolic and numerical checks (Python/SymPy) accompanying the paper by S. A. Tsilioukas on the Gauss-Bonnet contribution to the Wald entropy as the trace normalization of the type II algebra of a horizon.
